purpose: Link every manuscript claim in the LA-022 draft to exact experiments or clearly marked nonempirical implementation evidence. Historical LA-002 inspection pins remain provenance; they are not substituted for admitted run records.

optional_author_review.label: non-independent; not annotation, expert validation, agreement evidence, or a run dependency

trained skill normalizer or semantic encoder performance
QF_LIA interpolation and interactive kernel theorems
universal prevention or complete mediation beyond the selected ENFORCE sandbox route

claim_status_vocabulary.empirical_admitted: Retained admitted run with denominators, identities, and limitations.
claim_status_vocabulary.empirical_qualification: Executed qualification suite, not a scored arm rate.
claim_status_vocabulary.shared_producer_conformance: Structural agreement with a checker that shares the producer.
claim_status_vocabulary.protocol_unadmitted_diagnostic: Executed and retained, but not the admitted headline study.
claim_status_vocabulary.implementation_nonempirical: Inspectable code or configuration; not a measured research outcome.
claim_status_vocabulary.withdrawn_unmeasured: Explicit scoped removal; no invented numeric score.

prior_audit.note: v1 inspection statuses (implemented_unqualified, fixture_only, declared_only, unsupported) remain historically valid as of 2026-09-11. LA-022 overwrites paper-level claim language using later retained runs.

manuscript_claims.claim: Source-span linkage 60/60, schema validity 50/60, machine-contract coverage 60/60; four CVE adapter failures and six unsupported skill rows retained.
The LA-009 skill-validator 18/18 comparison is shared-producer conformance, not independent checker agreement.
CVE source-difference observation 24/24; polarity unknown 24/24; no untrusted source executed; transfer unsupported.
Expert-reviewed legal source-to-IR fidelity is withdrawn and unmeasured; no independent human legal/security/intent validation or inter-annotator agreement was collected.
The qualified proof route is QF_BOOL SAT with an independent truth-table checker; SAT cannot authorize theorem_proof allows; other families are unavailable rather than invented.
Selected ENFORCE mediation cases passed 14/14 with real Ed25519 verification; OFF/audit/unprotected routes are excluded from the safety claim.
not_established: coverage of arbitrary supervisor or MCP routes

manuscript_claims.claim: File-backed DuckDB consumption with typed Quack owner passed 14/14 selected-claim cases; in-memory restart is a labeled contrast; a DuckDB commit is not remote exactly-once.
Local stdio, loopback HTTP, and loopback libp2p carried identical allow/deny/unknown/wrong-audience/replay decisions; WAN and IPFS daemon are absent.
Closed-loop generated-code planning is explicitly withdrawn: 900/900 not_started, 0 model calls, 0 generated programs; not pooled with fixed-action results.
Original LA-015 rows, LA-016/LA-017 comparison wording, and LA-017 ablations are protocol-unadmitted diagnostic evidence.
not_established: headline safety rates from unadmitted cells

manuscript_claims.claim: LA-020 twelve-step traces are separate diagnostic replays of frozen A4 identities, including permitted useful work and prevented forbidden effects.
Evaluated corpus freeze is 30 families / 60 cases (6 legal, 12 CVE, 12 skill); release-card totals are unrecounted background.
not_established: full CVEfixes or SkillCenter release recount

manuscript_claims.claim: No trained skill normalizer or encoder is part of the evaluated contribution; the default is a deterministic structural normalizer.
Default OFF is pass-through and the default in-memory store is not the A4 restart-safety configuration.
Development A4 efficiency timings are instrumentation, not a 900-cell rescore; model tokens were unobserved and no price conversion was applied.
Closest related systems were cited from primary sources and were not executed as scored arms.
Semantic program worlds, learned residuals, refactoring, parallel sealing, and proof-carrying test reuse are not implemented contributions.
Manuscript generation requires no outside review; optional author review is non-independent.
Admitted operator costs: 902 host attempts, scientific_retries=0, group CPU 1608.817478 s, two pre-scientific startups at 591 and 625, original false host admissions 459 and 560 retained.
